The residue is real and is the BloodlinePower{1,3,9,15,20}LVLBonus / BloodlinePower1TimesBonus / EldrtichHeritage* family (a PCGen data defect). (3) 'PCGen prints 0' is only true for a bare identifier or a pure +/- chain: an undefined name makes processJepFormula return null for the WHOLE formula (VariableProcessor.java:463-471) and processBrokenParser (:215-410) then evaluates the uppercased string left-to-right with no precedence and no functions. (2) For the residue: Const(0) + defect list ONLY where the use is a bare identifier or a +/- chain; REFUSE per name where the use sits inside a function or under * or / (the oracle is not 0 there).
